decision.explanation: The question asks for the CEO of Facebook in 2021. Source D2 explicitly identifies Mark Zuckerberg as the 'Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer' (D2S1) and states he is the CEO of Meta (which was formerly Facebook) (D2S2). Source D3 confirms the timeframe includes 2021 (D3S1, D3S3, D3S4). While D1 mentions Elon Musk as CEO of Meta, this refers to his role at Meta (the parent company formed after the rebranding) and does not contradict Zuckerberg's specific role as CEO of the entity historically known as Facebook during the specified period, nor does it assign him the title of CEO of Facebook itself in the context of the provided text. The candidate 'Mark Zuckerberg' is directly supported by the text and fits the slot 'person' and constraint '2021'. No other valid referents for 'CEO of Facebook' are present in the sources.
